description: This source file defines classes and logic for representing and serializing method invocation responses in Orleans. It includes abstractions for responses with results, exceptions, and completion states, as well as serialization codecs and activation mechanisms specific to response types.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a method invocation response, including methods for creating responses from exceptions or results, and properties for accessing the result or exception.

classes.name: CompletedResponse
classes.description: Singleton class representing a completed response with no result or exception.

classes.name: CompletedResponseActivator
classes.description: Activator class for creating singleton instances of CompletedResponse.

classes.name: ExceptionResponse
classes.description: Represents a response that encapsulates an exception, throwing it upon result access.

classes.name: Response<TResult>
classes.description: A typed response class holding a result of type TResult, with support for serialization and disposal.

classes.name: ResponseCodec
classes.description: Abstract base class for raw serialization of Response objects.

classes.name: PooledResponseCodec<TResult>
classes.description: Codec class for serializing/deserializing Response<TResult> instances with pooled results.

classes.name: PooledResponseCopier<TResult>
classes.description: Deep copier for Response<TResult> objects, supporting object pooling.

classes.name: PooledResponseActivator<TResult>
classes.description: Activator for creating pooled Response<TResult> objects.

classes.name: ResponseExtensions
classes.description: Extension methods for Response, such as throwing stored exceptions.

methods.name: Response.FromException
methods.description: Creates a Response encapsulating an exception.

methods.name: Response.FromResult
methods.description: Creates a Response with a specified result.

methods.name: Response.Completed
methods.description: Gets a singleton completed response instance.

methods.name: Response<TResult>.GetResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result cast to specified type.

methods.name: Response<TResult>.Dispose
methods.description: Returns the Response instance to the pool and clears its result.

methods.name: ResponseExtensions.ThrowIfExceptionResponse
methods.description: Throws the exception stored in the Response if it exists.
